about: Accepted health numbers. Regenerate with: node tools/health.mjs --write-baseline. node tools/health.mjs --compare exits 1 when a metric moves past max(abs, rel * |value|) in its bad direction (bad: up, down, both). See tools/health.mjs for the personas.

casual.firstGoalSec.note: seconds of play to the first zone boss win

casual.longestDrySec.note: longest active stretch without a reward

casual.visitsWithRewardShare.note: share of 5-minute visits that gave something

casual.zoneEnd.note: zone after 3 days of 3 short visits

casual.mechanicsPerHour.note: new unlocks and camp builds per active hour

active.firstGoalSec.note: seconds to the first zone boss win

active.firstRewardSec.note: seconds to the first reward of any kind

active.longestDrySec.note: longest active stretch without a reward

active.stallCount.note: stalls (10 active minutes without a new zone)

active.longestStallSec.note: longest stretch without a new zone

active.wipesPerHour.note: times the hero fell, per hour

active.goldSpentShare.note: share of gold earned that was spent

active.abilityTopShare.note: dominance: the most-cast ability, share of casts

active.mechanicsPerHour.note: new unlocks and camp builds per active hour

active.mechanicsBurst10min.note: most unlocks and camp builds inside any 10 minutes

active.heroParity.note: widest gap of a starter from the median zone (share)

optimiser.zoneEnd.note: zone after 10 hours of best-value play

optimiser.longestDrySec.note: longest active stretch without a reward

optimiser.stallCount.note: stalls (10 active minutes without a new zone)

optimiser.longestStallSec.note: longest stretch without a new zone

optimiser.wipesPerHour.note: times the hero fell, per hour

optimiser.goldSpentShare.note: share of gold earned that was spent (a sink gap if it falls)

optimiser.essHeldShare.note: essence made but still unspent at the end

optimiser.deadFamilies.note: dead stock: material families with 90% or more of what was gathered still unspent

optimiser.abilityTopShare.note: dominance: the most-cast ability, share of casts

optimiser.trainTopShare.note: dominance: the most-trained move, share of Training levels

optimiser.gearTierMean.note: average tier of worn class gear

optimiser.mechanicsPerHour.note: new unlocks and camp builds per active hour

optimiser.mechanicsBurst10min.note: most unlocks and camp builds inside any 10 minutes

optimiser.heroParity.note: widest gap of a starter from the median zone (share)

caps.about: Absolute caps beside the tolerances (self-improving plan F4). Report only: node tools/health.mjs prints runs over a cap and never fails on one. Each cap names a per-run metric and its maximum.

newThingsPer3min.note: new unlocks and camp builds in any 3 minutes of the first 30 active minutes

newThingsPer10min.note: new unlocks and camp builds in any 10 minutes

budget.about: The accepted difficulty budget (tools/budget.mjs): each cell "row|hero|player" is the mean and sd of 5 seed offsets. Bands, gaps and tolerances: docs/design/difficulty-budget.json. Regenerate with: node tools/health.mjs --write-baseline (or --only budget --write-baseline).

long.about: The 50-hour run (node tools/health.mjs --long). Regenerate with: node tools/health.mjs --long --write-baseline (mean of 3 seed offsets, about 8 min on 3 free cores). sd is the spread of the mean over those seeds. node tools/health.mjs --long --compare uses this section.

long.zoneEnd.note: zone after 50 hours of best-value play

long.lastNewZoneHour.note: hour of the last new zone (a fall means the world ran out sooner)

long.sinceLastZoneHours.note: hours at the end of the run since the last new zone (progress wall)

long.postZoneShare.note: share of the run spent past the last new zone

long.postNewThingShare.note: share of the run spent past the last unlock, zone, camp building, Proving, hire, or Star found (empty endgame)

long.stallsOver1h.note: stretches of an hour or more without a new zone

long.longestStallSec.note: longest stretch without a new zone

long.wipesPerHour.note: times the hero fell, per hour

long.goldSpentShare.note: share of gold earned that was spent (a sink gap if it falls)

long.essHeldShare.note: essence made but still unspent at the end

long.deadFamilies.note: dead stock: material families with 90% or more of what was gathered still unspent

long.abilityTopShare.note: dominance (reference): the most-cast ability, share of casts

long.trainTopShare.note: dominance (reference): the most-trained move, share of Training levels

long.gearTierMean.note: average tier of worn class gear at the end

long.mechanicsPerHour.note: new unlocks and camp builds per active hour

long.heroParity.note: widest gap of a starter from the median zone (share)

long.stallsOver3h.note: stretches of three hours or more without a new zone (a new long wall)
